caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative object in the form of a seated cat. The cat’s body is mostly dark brown with various patches of lighter brown and black, giving it a mottled appearance. The ears are upright and colored reddish-brown on the interior. The cat has yellowish eyes with black pupils, and its facial features, including nose and mouth, are outlined in black. Around the neck is a greenish collar with red and yellow decorations, and a red pendant hangs from it at the front. The cat is sitting on a rectangular base that is dark brown with subtle greenish and yellowish highlights, and the base features embossed or carved decorative patterns along the sides. There is a circular pattern in red and green on the left side of the cat near the haunches. The drawing itself is contained within a single-line rectangular border on a plain background.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Cat
